item.title: Compression makes reasoning models look safer, not safe
item.description: The efficiency-safety dilemma in reasoning models, where compression lowers measured harmfulness mainly by degrading capability; the Turing-test gap in preference alignment; and a value-sensitive delegation study of OpenClaw users. Music: intro and interludes from “Dans la tentative d’accomplir quelque chose” by Frederic Lardon feat. Laura Palmée (CC0). Outro: “Crap Transition” by Jesse Spillane, https://freemusicarchive.org/music/Jesse_Spillane/Art_of_Presentation/Jesse_Spillane_-_Art_of_Presentation_-_04_Crap_Transition/ licensed CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/); trimmed, faded and mixed with narration.
